purpose: Combine a confirmed modeled energy-outage scenario with separately sourced Storm guardian weather assessment, configuration, and recent activity.
primaryGoal: Model supported-energy survival and risk progression, inspect load priorities and evidence, and independently configure pre-storm charging protection for the selected vehicle.

dataSources.ownership: Advanced intelligence service; page submits explicit user scenario, not observed vehicle energy.
dataSources.behavior: Mutation toast; confirmed:true; SI body; useRetainedMutation retains successful raw response and submitted inputs, rejecting old-vehicle publication.
dataSources.verified: Source path/method match only; server calculations and live response not exercised.

dataSources.ownership: Storm guardian; config, weather assessment and optional current_soc.
dataSources.behavior: Operational query policy; vehicle-keyed cache; forwarded abort signal; selected vehicle required.
Operational query policy; safeArray response; activity renderer shows first five returned entries with independent source state.

dataSources.ownership: Storm guardian existing configuration mutation; not the modeled outage-plan mutation.
dataSources.behavior: Saves enabled, lat, lng and target_soc for vehicle_id; invalidates/broadcasts that vehicle's status/events and publishes toast.
dataSources.verified: Source capability is configuration persistence. Actual automatic command execution and evaluator behavior were not audited.

dataSources.ownership: Existing workspace selection and display preferences.
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle precedence is URL, persisted valid selection, then first vehicle. Workspace route scope enables vehicle and disables shared range here. Scenario duration is an independent modeled business duration, not a historical date filter.

components.name: PageLayout
components.contract: PageContainer adapter; full-width min-w-0 container; shell retains selection/header ownership.

components.name: ChartCard / EmbeddedChart
components.contract: One LayoutCard surface; forwards data, dataColumns, toolbar, exportable and semantic chart labels to canonical ChartContainer.

components.name: InsightPanel / SourceContent
components.contract: Persistent LayoutCard shell; source-specific loading/error/empty/retained/ready rendering; query-driven recovery.

components.name: AnalysisBrief / OperationalBrief
components.contract: Raw numeric StatMetric measurements; source quality, provenance, generatedAt, window, retained failures and submitted result scope.

components.name: EvidencePanel
components.contract: Quality KVList, evidence source cards, limitations, explicit unsupported capabilities; null-safe collections.

components.name: StormGuardPanel / StormGuardActivity
components.contract: Independent operational status and events; Toggle/Input/Slider/Button configuration controls.

components.name: SiNumberInput
components.contract: Canonical SI number entry through shared Input, display-equivalent hint, min/max/required and null-capable change callback.

components.name: Badge / Button / Input / Text / AlertBanner / EmptyState / FadeIn
components.contract: Already reused; no new primitive or animation engine required. Full primitive behavior not independently inspected.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Six SI scenario inputs repeat value-to-form updates and display-equivalent hints, but already share SiNumberInput. AnalysisBrief and EvidencePanel also intentionally repeat source provenance at summary/detail levels.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse the current SI field and brief/evidence owners; optionally use local typed field metadata without removing validation or any hint. Do not introduce another form, metric, or evidence component family.

Priorities/recommendations stack then split at lg: EmergencyResiliencePage.tsx:250.
Evidence stacks then uses three lg columns: EvidencePanel.tsx:45.

findings.detail: Home-coordinate controls are an unconditional two-column grid, unlike the page's responsive scenario fields. This leaves narrow columns for labels, decimal values and control chrome on small allocated widths.
findings.fix: Use an intentional small-container stacking strategy retaining both coordinates and all configuration actions; check 320px and long localized labels before choosing the breakpoint.

responsive.limits: No viewport, touch, text-zoom, RTL, overflow, or visual behavior exercised. Fixed chart height is recorded as a sizing integration concern, not a proven overflow defect.

sourceEvidence: Decorative page icons are aria-hidden: EmergencyResiliencePage.tsx:79,177.
Scenario uses native form submit and shared labeled numeric controls: EmergencyResiliencePage.tsx:93,95,161.
Chart has ariaLabel and exported dataColumns including risk: EmergencyResiliencePage.tsx:212,220.
Evidence subsections and activity have localized aria-labels: EvidencePanel.tsx:46; StormGuardActivity.tsx:17.
accessibility.limits: Keyboard, focus visibility/order, generated Input associations, slider behavior, screen-reader announcements, effective contrast, reduced-motion, forced colors and accessible chart data interaction are unverified. No claim of AA compliance.

sourceEvidence: No vehicle disables scenario submission; summary prompts selection. Storm config has its own selection prompt.
Mutation pending disables/spins submit; useRetainedMutation keeps prior success with scope and submitted-input identity.
AnalysisBrief distinguishes initial pending, retained failure, refresh, fatal failure, uncalculated result and missing quality.
Storm status has initial Skeleton, fatal QueryError, unavailable assessment and retained stale notice. Events have independent SourceContent.
Chart requires at least two points; action/evidence arrays are null-safe.

findings.detail: Timeline receives only empty/data; priorities at line 247 receive only empty=!result; EvidencePanel at line 270 receives no request state. During a first pending/failing/paused calculation these sections continue showing insufficient/no-generated/no-supporting-evidence copy while AnalysisBrief alone distinguishes the request state.
findings.fix: Derive per-result source state from publication.source and propagate pending/fatal/retained semantics through existing chart/panel contracts. Keep source sections mounted and retain usable previous outputs after refresh failure; never infer empty evidence from an unresolved request.

findings.detail: With a successful result containing an empty load_priorities or recommendations array, the outer panel is ready because result exists but that column renders nothing; individual collection emptiness is not explained.
findings.fix: Add localized collection-specific empty messages while preserving nonempty neighboring recommendations/priorities.

visualIssues.detail: Priority cards use a fixed white-opacity border. The related EvidencePanel source cards at line 83 use fixed white-opacity border and background, bypassing neutral theme surface tokens.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing subtle-border/surface tokens on both card patterns, retaining evidence hierarchy and semantic warning badges; no neon/glow or new palette.

visualIssues.detail: The SI suffix uses raw text-xs rather than the existing Caption/Text role. The text color already uses a theme variable.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse Caption or Text as span with the correct compact role without changing Input suffix/hint associations or canonical units.

architectureIssues.detail: stored config hydrates local form only once via hydrated. This state is never reset on vehicleId change. Switching from vehicle A to B preserves A's enabled/coordinates/target while handleSave at line 64 sends those values with B's vehicle_id.
architectureIssues.fix: Key configuration draft/hydration and mutation error publication to vehicle scope, hydrating B only from B's resolved config. Preserve edits during same-vehicle refetch; prevent late old-scope responses or save errors publishing in the new scope.

architectureIssues.detail: Global 'Advisory plan only' copy says TeslaSync does not execute emergency commands, immediately followed by a separate Storm guardian configuration surface labeled 'Auto pre-charge before storms' (StormGuardPanel.tsx:134). The plan's advisory limitations and guardian's independent configuration capability are not clearly scoped.
architectureIssues.fix: Explicitly scope the no-dispatch/no-V2H disclaimer to the modeled outage plan and separately describe the existing guardian configuration. Do not infer additional commands, evaluator guarantees, charging authorization, or actual backend execution from frontend labels.

architectureIssues.detail: Every SiNumberInput null from cleared/nonfinite input is immediately replaced with zero. Zero is valid for energy/reserve fields; uncertainty also converts empty string to zero at line 169. Clearing a required field therefore changes the scenario into a measured zero instead of retaining an incomplete draft.
architectureIssues.fix: Represent incomplete draft values separately and validate the complete typed SI request at submit. Preserve legitimate zero and all current minimum/maximum constraints and defaults.

architectureIssues.detail: Bare Tooltip uses raw series key energy and default numeric formatting; data table/export column labels at lines 220-222 omit the selected duration/energy units even though values are already converted at lines 62-63. Exported time/energy can be ambiguous across unit preferences.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing localized chart tooltip/formatting conventions and include selected display-unit context in chart table/export headers. Preserve raw response SI and every risk point; do not create another conversion engine.

architectureIssues.detail: Peak gust interpolates a number with hardcoded m/s display copy rather than useUnits speed display formatting. This bypasses the user's display speed unit preference; the API field peak_gust_ms is not renamed or reinterpreted by this audit.
architectureIssues.fix: First confirm the existing API field's unit contract, then apply the existing SI display formatter at the render boundary and localize unit-bearing output. Retain raw wire/cache field and values.

order: Clarify modeled-plan versus guardian capability boundaries
Propagate per-source trust states and preserve incomplete draft input
Normalize token surfaces and unit-bearing chart outputs
priority.rationale: Cross-vehicle configuration submission risk outweighs cosmetic modernization.

requiredSharedChanges.name: StormGuardPanel scope-safe configuration draft
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Keep vehicleId?:number|null. Define draft identity/hydration for each selected vehicle; initial/unavailable/retained status; dirty same-scope draft; old-scope save/error suppression; narrow-width coordinate stacking.
requiredSharedChanges.acceptance: Source-focused tests then authorized runtime A-to-B selection/save, late response, retained refetch and narrow-view checks. No backend feature additions.

requiredSharedChanges.name: EvidencePanel unresolved/result source presentation
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Retain quality/evidence/limitations/unsupported props; compose existing InsightPanel query or explicit sourceState for initial/loading/error/retained versus genuinely empty evidence. Neutral theme tokens for evidence cards.
requiredSharedChanges.acceptance: No response, pending, paused, fatal failure, retained failure, empty successful evidence and sibling independence. Other consumers must be inventoried by the assigned shared owner; none inferred here.

requiredSharedChanges.name: SiNumberInput typography reuse
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing suffix display via Caption/Text; retain null callback, explicit ID, required/min/max/step and hint behavior.
requiredSharedChanges.acceptance: Suffix, units, label and hint stay visible and associated. Draft null preservation belongs to page, not a shared conversion change.

competingImplementations.finding: No new theme, query client, workspace selector, metric formatter or chart engine found in this scoped source review.
competingImplementations.evidence: Existing PageLayout, AnalysisBrief, useOperationalMetrics, useSelectedVehicle, useUnits, SourceContent and category chart imports are reused.

competingImplementations.finding: Presentation mixes GlassPanel-based guardian with LayoutCard-based intelligence panels; both are existing canonical owners, not proof of a competing library.
competingImplementations.fix: Unify spacing/hierarchy through existing layouts only if all guardian content/actions and source states survive.

actions: Edit six SI inputs and restoration uncertainty, preserving current defaults and validation bounds.
Create confirmed outage plan with selected vehicle, pending disable/loading and success/error toast.
Edit guardian enabled/home latitude/home longitude/target_soc and Save guard.
Retry guardian status and independent recent activity through current query refetch.
Retain canonical timeline toolbar/data-table/export affordances and all risk column values.
dataBehavior: Canonical raw SI request/cache/response; display-only duration and energy conversion.
Simulation response retains vehicle_id, survival_horizon_s, every risk_timeline point, priority, recommendation, quality, evidence, limitation and generated_at.
Retained successful result belongs to submitted inputs and vehicle, not the currently edited form; old-vehicle results do not publish.
Storm status/events remain distinct from modeled scenario; preserve operational query policy, cancellation, query keys, limit=10 and existing first-five activity presentation.
Do not add date filtering unsupported by these current sources or another page vehicle picker; workspace owns selected vehicle.
Preserve advisory/no automatic load shedding/no assumed V2H messages while correctly scoping them.
Risk is preserved in chart data table/export even though only remaining energy is drawn as a line.
